strategy.primary: Equipment free-cast: keep high-mana-value Equipment on Tetsuo, then each equipped attack either deals damage equal to the highest Equipment MV or casts an instant/sorcery from hand for free, ideally an extra combat (Savage Beating, World at War) or a suspend card (Ancestral Vision, Profane Tutor, Wheel of Fate).
strategy.secondary: Voltron damage as a real second win, with the extra-combat package (Genji Glove, Hexplate Wallbreaker, Akki Battle Squad, Godo, Aggravated Assault + Sword of Feast and Famine).

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Tetsuo, Imperial Champion
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Whenever Tetsuo attacks, if it's equipped, choose one —
• Tetsuo deals damage equal to the greatest mana value among Equipment attached to it to any target.
• You may cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand with mana value less than or equal to the greatest mana value among Equipment attached to Tetsuo without paying its mana cost.

identity.why: Equipped attack: burn or free spell.
Very high MV for the trigger.
